series.name: HDU-24CA03 ducted (model-scoped)
series.notes: Model-scoped ducted meanings (Arlington). E0=power, E1=keypad, E4=STOP tank full — conflict with split + HDU-42 — keep separate.

meaning.en: On this model E0 flags power-supply problems: low voltage or abnormal consumption — not the drain meaning used on HDU-42CA03.
meaning.ur: Is model par E0 power supply ke masle batata hai: low voltage ya abnormal consumption — HDU-42CA03 wale drain matlab se alag.

causes.en: Low voltage on the power line

causes.ur: unit ka achank zyada bjalay khana

solutions.en: Power off, unplug for 10 minutes, then restart
solutions.ur: band kr ke plg nkalein 10 minute baad on karein

solutions.en: Call a technician if the error persists
solutions.ur: kharabi baqi rahe to technician blaiyn

notes.en: E0 meaning differs across HDU models (42=drain, 24=power) and from appliancecodehub split E0 (sensor/EEPROM). Keep model-scoped.
notes.ur: E0 ka matlab alag alag HDU models (42=drain, 24=power) mein farq karta hai aur appliancecodehub split E0 (sensor/EEPROM) se bhi alag hai. Ise model-scoped hi rakhein.

title.ur: front keypad ka button atka hua (HDU-24CA03)

meaning.en: A front-panel button is stuck or not releasing, so the unit reports E1.
meaning.ur: Front panel ka koi button phans gaya hai ya wapas nahi aa raha, is liye unit E1 batata hai

causes.en: Stuck or non-working button on front keypad
causes.ur: front keypad par button phansa hua ya kaam nahi kar raha

causes.en: Moisture or dirt under the button keeping it pressed
causes.ur: Button ke neeche gandagi ya paani lag kar button khud se daba hua rehta hai

causes.en: Loose or disconnected keypad wiring to the indoor control board
causes.ur: Keypad ki wiring indoor control board se dhili ya khuli hai

solutions.en: Power off, unplug, press each button gently to reset
solutions.ur: band karke plug off kar ke har button dheere se dba kar restart karein

solutions.en: Technician opens keypad panel to verify connections if stuck remains
solutions.ur: button atka hua rahe to technician keypad panel khol kar connections check kare

notes.en: Model-scoped; conflicts with split E1 (room sensor) and HDU-42 E1 (high pressure).
notes.ur: Model-scoped hai; split E1 (room sensor) aur HDU-42 E1 (high pressure) se conflict karta hai.

meaning.en: Condensate tank/tray full or float stuck; display may show "E4, STOP" and the unit will not run until cleared.
meaning.ur: Condensate tank/tray bhar gaya ya float phansa hua hai. Display par "E4, STOP" aata hai aur saaf hone tak unit nahin chalta

causes.ur: Tank/tray bhar gaya, khaali karna zaroori

solutions.en: Drain all water from the tank via hose/pipe
solutions.ur: hose/pipe se tank ka sara paani nikalein

solutions.en: Clean reservoir of dirt/debris and free the float
solutions.ur: reservoir se gandagi/debris saaf karein aur float ko aazad karein

notes.en: Alias STOP comes from source display "E4, STOP". Conflicts with split E4 (indoor EEPROM) — model-scoped.
notes.ur: STOP alias source ke display "E4, STOP" se aaya hai. Split E4 (indoor EEPROM) se conflict karta hai — ise model-scoped hi rakha gaya hai.

title.ur: mahol ka zyada darja hararat (99°F / 37°C se aopar)

meaning.en: Text "High Temp" shows when ambient room temperature exceeds about 99°F (37°C).
meaning.ur: jab kamre ka temperature takriban 99°F (37°C) se upar chala jaye to "High Temp" likha jata hai

causes.en: Ambient room temperature above normal limit
causes.ur: kamre ka mahol temperature normal had se zyada hai

causes.en: Direct sunlight or heat sources near the unit raising room temperature
causes.ur: Unit ke paas dhoop ya heat source se kamre ka darja hararat barh jata hai

causes.en: Blocked condenser or poor ventilation trapping heat in the room
causes.ur: Condenser band ho ya ventilation theek na ho — is se garmi kamre se bahar nahi nikalti

solutions.en: Power off and let the system cool down completely
solutions.ur: band karke system ko poora thanda hone dein

solutions.en: If it appears at normal temperature after restart, call HVAC service
solutions.ur: Agar normal temperature par restart ke baad bhi aaye to HVAC service bulayein

notes.en: Display is a text token, not an E/F code.
notes.ur: Display par E/F code nahi, balkay text token aata hai.
